create_execution_record: create an ExecutionRecord from a code object with globals, locals, builtins, and code_options
dump_execution_record: dump an ExecutionRecord to a file using dill serialization
load_execution_record: load an ExecutionRecord from a dill-serialized file
build_execution_recorder: build an ExecutionRecorder to track code execution with module access and variable recording
test_get_record: test ExecutionRecorder.get_record to produce an ExecutionRecord with resolved module references
